title: Deployment-run QA
summary: Acceptance and execution use complete frozen item-case selections; attached post-deploy plans run as plan groups. Authorized withdrawals and replacements retain source ancestry and target checks. An incomplete historical selection names operator repair recovery; raw historical requirements and results remain viewable without current-definition reinterpretation. A member walks only its own item cases on its own scoped cursor. Each plan group is gated as a run-scoped subject and closes on its own; member acceptance never waits on group rows, and an item is done only once a closed group covers it. --plan at item-qa names the plan's open group without adding obligations or refreshing live content; no command selects one member's plan cases. New plans fill empty stages; explicit corrections retain replacement validation. A selector conflicting with a private member cursor names the existing execution and owner-resume recovery while retaining custody. Removal retracts an open group with no attaching member left, never its passed rows; a retracted group is never reused. Supplemental runs enroll members with plans owed at their environment even without item cases. A completion run answers not required when all attached or default plans target elsewhere, but done still needs their closed-group credit. Plan-backed rows use member, plan, item, then run project precedence across execution and evidence reads. Settlement reads the same member plan disposition as the QA stage: an empty member whose plans target elsewhere defers and leaves the run free to succeed, while the item stays open for its other-target plan credit. Own run cases and plans owed on the current target still block until satisfied. Failure notices remain active until the member has full QA credit, including shared groups; closing one group withdraws only its own member notices and preserves other groups.
